header.title: Professional Onboarding
header.subtitle: Complete these steps to submit your profile for approval.

idUpload.subtitle: Upload your ID proof and provide document details.

business.title: Business Info
business.subtitle: Provide company details and VAT information.
business.usernameHint: This is how customers will see you. Your company name will be hidden from customers.
business.usernameRules: 3-30 characters, lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only
business.usernameCompanyConflict: Username cannot be the same as your company name
business.servicesHint: Loaded from the admin-managed service configuration.

availability.companySubtitle: Set your company working hours. At least one day is required.
availability.personalSubtitle: Optional. Set your own weekly schedule now or skip it for later.

employees.title: Employees
employees.subtitle: Optional. Invite employees now or skip.

stripe.title: Stripe Integration
stripe.subtitle: This step cannot be skipped. Stripe must be connected before onboarding can continue.
stripe.incomplete: Stripe account exists, but onboarding is not complete yet.

rules.title: Platform Rules
rules.subtitle: Review the rules and accept the required checkboxes before submitting.

items.gdpr: Must comply with GDPR and data protection regulations
items.professional: Deliver services professionally, safely, on time, and in accordance with applicable laws and regulations
items.communication: Use the platform for all communication, agreements, and payments (no off-platform transactions)
items.inform: Always inform the customer in advance before triggering platform actions to ensure transparency and smoother approval.

misbehavior.misleading: Providing misleading, incomplete, or false information (including fraudulent documents or invalid certifications)
misbehavior.dataMisuse: Misuse of customer data or violation of privacy rules

consequences.ranking: Decreasing ranking & visibility on the platform

rules.agreeRules: I agree to the platform rules and consequences
rules.agreeTerms: I accept the General Terms & Conditions
rules.agreeSelfBilling: I agree that Fixtract prepares and issues invoices on my behalf (self-billing agreement)

vat.onlyEu: Only EU VAT numbers can be validated with VIES

toasts.idDetailsRequired: Please provide ID country of issue and expiration date
toasts.usernameLength: Username must be between 3 and 30 characters
toasts.selectValidAddress: Please select a valid address from the suggestions
toasts.availableDayRequired: Select at least one available day
toasts.invalidTimeRange: Start time must be earlier than end time
toasts.companyHoursInvalid: Please fix invalid company availability time ranges
toasts.personalHoursInvalid: Please fix invalid personal availability time ranges
toasts.acceptAgreements: Please accept all agreements to continue
toasts.completeSteps: Please complete required steps before submitting

vatFormat.countryPrefix: VAT number must start with 2 letters (country code)
vatFormat.invalidCountry: {country} is not a valid EU country code
vatFormat.network: Network error occurred while validating VAT number

support.title: Professional Support
support.subtitle: Open a ticket, request a meeting, or chat with us.

meeting.timesPlaceholder: Preferred dates/times (e.g. 'Mon–Wed morning, any time after 10:00')
meeting.helper: Admin will confirm with a scheduled time. Availability-based booking is coming soon.
meeting.required: Topic and preferred times are required

chat.emptyBody: Our team will reach out here, or raise a support ticket above and we'll follow up.
chat.teamSubtitle: You're chatting with our support team
chat.noMessages: No messages yet. Say hello to start the conversation.

setup.title: Connect Your Stripe Account
setup.subtitle: Start receiving payments from customers by connecting your Stripe account
setup.connectedBody: Your Stripe account is fully set up and ready to receive payments
setup.redirectNotice: You'll be redirected to Stripe's secure platform to complete the setup process. This typically takes 5-10 minutes.
setup.terms: By connecting, you agree to Stripe's Terms of Service and Privacy Policy

complete.successBody: Your account is fully set up and ready to receive payments from customers
complete.successOnboardingNote: You'll be taken back to complete the remaining onboarding steps
complete.successDashboardNote: You can now accept bookings and receive payments
complete.incompleteBody: Your Stripe account setup is not fully complete. You need to finish the onboarding process to receive payments.
complete.errorBody: We couldn't verify your Stripe account status. Please try again.

refresh.title: Onboarding Link Expired
refresh.body: Your Stripe onboarding link has expired. Don't worry - we can generate a new one for you to continue where you left off.
refresh.footnote: Your progress is saved. The new link will take you back to where you left off.
refresh.createFailed: Failed to create new onboarding link
